figmaFile.name: Design System - BS4 Foundation Component Library

sets.name: AI label
sets.notes: Created 2026-08-29 on the Badge page, BESIDE the four AI surfaces the product invented locally rather than instead of them. No brand hue is picked: the ground is achromatic and the accent is a border and a glyph, so the branding decision lands on one value. Published: all 6 variants (origin × confidence) present in the 2026-09-15 components snapshot.

sets.name: Button page (Core)
sets.notes: The Button page in Core: Updated components, Docs and Playground. Read-only from code.

sets.name: _Calendar
sets.notes: The month grid DatePicker and DateTimePicker open, one variant per size. In code it is the public `Calendar`, wrapping the shared `_internal/Calendar.jsx` the pickers also use.

sets.name: Choice Grid
sets.notes: Rebuilt on Form Checkbox and Form Radio Button with a `type` axis and a `_Choice Grid Row` part. The separate CheckBox Grid set (13541:9240) was deleted.

sets.name: Count tag
sets.notes: On the Labels page, Status, count & tag. Figma values carry a (default) suffix on subtle, neutral and default; hasRing is the ring in Figma. Inverse exists in neutral only, and dot at default spacing only. Docs page: node 17883:1895.

sets.name: DatePicker
sets.notes: state closed · open · invalid · valid · read-only · disabled × filled? × range? × spacing. A `_Field` trigger with the calendar-day icon in Trailing; the open variants show `_Calendar` in `_Listbox` Body, 4px (`--stack-sm`) below the field, left-aligned, flipping above when there is no room. `range` and `spacing` are the code props of the same names. Signed off; it is `unpublished` until the library is next published, when it can move to `verified`.

sets.name: _Calendar
sets.notes: The month grid both pickers open, one variant per size. In code it is `_internal/Calendar.jsx`, which is not exported from the barrel. The `_` prefix keeps the library from publishing it, so `unpublished` is its settled state.

sets.name: _Calendar Day
sets.notes: One day cell: default, hover, selected, disabled, today, in range and outside the month, at three sizes. In code it is the day button inside `_internal/Calendar.jsx`. The `_` prefix keeps the library from publishing it, so `unpublished` is its settled state.

sets.name: DateTimePicker
sets.notes: A date field and a time field side by side with the time-zone caption beneath: state closed · date open · time open · read-only · disabled × invalid · valid × filled? × spacing. The calendar is the shared `_Calendar` DatePicker opens, 4px (`--stack-sm`) below the date field, left-aligned, flipping above. Signed off; it is `unpublished` until the library is next published, when it can move to `verified`. The time half is the public `Time picker` set — see its own page.

sets.name: Dynamic table (page)
sets.notes: The Dynamic table page: sort, filter, selection with bulk actions, paging, expanding rows, a frozen column and the loading, empty and error states.

sets.name: Footnote
sets.notes: Points at the COMPONENT (111:227940), not the instance. It used to name 111:227939, which is an instance of it — the note here asked design to “promote it to a component”, but the component already existed and the registry was simply linking a copy of it. No variants: not a component set.

sets.name: Character
sets.notes: On the Illustrations page. Figma names each character in words ("mastering content"); code takes the same name in kebab-case ("mastering-content"). Size is not a Figma property: the set is drawn at 1000 and scaled, and the Docs name 48, 96, 160 and 240.

sets.name: Logo
sets.notes: style and size map one-to-one by name. The Figma variant group is `text?` (with the question mark) and its values are the STRINGS "true"/"false", while the code prop `text` is a real boolean — convert, do not pass the string through.

sets.name: Maintenance Alert
sets.notes: Single component, no variant set.

sets.name: Page Layout
sets.notes: Single component composing Top Bar + Sidebar + Pattern/Surface container. The nested Content slot is a real native SLOT; only the instructional copy inside it is stale.

sets.name: Scrollbar
sets.notes: Single component, not a variant set — no variant props to map.

sets.name: Skeleton
sets.notes: On the Loading page. Figma has one preset property for shapes and presets alike (rect (default), circle, text, paragraph and the label presets); code takes all ten values as preset, and rect, circle and text are also shape, which resize freely either way. shimmer? is isShimmering, off by default in Figma so static designs read clearly and on by default in code. Docs page: node 17885:47731.

sets.name: Static table (page)
sets.notes: The Static table page: the Static table set and the shared _Table parts it is built from.

sets.name: Suggestion
sets.notes: On the AI Label page (docs page: node 17885:57). Figma marks defaults in the value name ("insert (default)", "rest (default)"); code takes the bare value. The state axis (rest, hover, pressed, focus) is the browser's own :hover, :active and :focus-visible, never a prop; state=disabled is the native disabled button, from isDisabled or from a disabled field's or TagGroup's TagContext.

sets.name: _Tab Item
sets.notes: One tab in the strip: Tabs.Tab. state × selected, 9 variants. selected=true is the root's activeKey; state=disabled is isDisabled; hover, pressed and focus are the browser's own :hover, :active and :focus-visible, never a prop. Figma draws no disabled + selected variant.

sets.name: Tag
sets.notes: On the Status, Count & Tag page (docs page: node 17884:2099). Figma values carry a (default) suffix on gray, plain, read-only, rest and false. state=saving is isLoading; state=disabled is isDisabled, or TagContext for a whole field; remove? on a link is href plus isRemovable; count? is trailingMetric. type is the same four values in code (plain, person, agent, team); the avatar slot is the avatar prop, with initials when it is missing. elevated=true is isElevated, drawn for read-only and link on plain, person, agent and team, including disabled and focus × on a link's separate ×; code ignores it on a removable or selectable tag with a warning.

sets.name: TagGroup
sets.notes: On the Status, Count & Tag page (docs page: node 17884:2099). Figma values carry a (default) suffix on wrap, left and false; left and right are start and end in code, and disabled is isDisabled. The Tags slot (preferred values Tag and Suggestion) is children. The +n is a gray selectable Tag with no swatch (TagGroup hides it); code sizes the collapsed row by width, where Figma draws two tags and +n. Suggestions are never counted into +n and stay after it; menu items keep their tag's action (selectable toggles, link opens with a trailing arrow); remove stays on the row.

sets.name: TagInput
sets.notes: 3 sizes × 10 states: empty, filled, focus, typing, create, option menu, reordering, invalid, read-only and disabled. `size` is the code prop of the same name. `state` draws code's live states still: empty and filled are the tags, focus and typing are focus and the typed text (the hovered row shows its "…" when the field has a menu handler), create is a Create row in the list, option menu is the `_Option menu` open from a row's "…" (`onRename`, `onDelete`, `onColorChange`), reordering is a row lifted by its handle with the drop line and the keys in the hint (`onReorder`), and invalid, read-only and disabled are `validation="invalid"`, `readOnly` and `disabled`. The rows are Dropdown list Item, whose `state=dragging` and `drop indicator?` are OptionRow's `dragging` and `dropIndicator="before"`. Signed off; the library publishes it once the Specs file's text migration is ready, and the status becomes `verified` then.

sets.name: _Option menu
sets.notes: The menu a TagInput row's "…" opens: a `_Listbox` whose Header holds a small field for the name, the Figma Form (code: `TextField spacing="compact"`, Enter renames, Esc cancels), and whose Body holds Dropdown list Item rows: Delete with a trash icon and a divider, then a Color heading and one row per Tag color showing the Tag, the current one `state=selected`. It opens 4px under the "…", right-aligned to it. Each part shows only when its handler is passed.

sets.name: Tile
sets.notes: On the Iconography, Logos & Imagery page. Figma marks defaults in the value name ("32 (default)", "subtle (default)", "gray (default)"); code takes the bare value. Logo and image variants hold a media slot, which code fills with `children` or `src`. Image variants exist for gray only, since the picture covers the ground.

sets.name: Time picker
sets.notes: Hours, minutes and an AM/PM menu that opens 4px (`--stack-sm`) below: state × filled? × spacing. Same field anatomy as DatePicker. In code it is `TimePicker.jsx`.

sets.name: Top Bar
sets.notes: Names diverge across the boundary: Figma spells this `expand?` with boolean values, code spells it `mode` with 'expanded' | 'collapsed'. Verified against the TopBar props table in Storybook.

sets.name: Tree table (page)
sets.notes: The Tree table page: records nested up to three levels, built from _Tree row. No code component draws it yet.

Pattern/Surface container.notes: Content is a real native SLOT (verified via the Plugin API: type === 'SLOT'). The '◇ Content — convert this frame to a slot' line still sitting inside it is stale instructional copy, not an unconverted frame — cosmetic cleanup only, it does not block write-back.

Pattern/Table.notes: All three are real native SLOTs (verified via the Plugin API: type === 'SLOT'). The '◇ … — convert this frame to a slot' lines inside them are stale instructional copy, not unconverted frames — cosmetic cleanup only, they do not block write-back.
